patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I stood up in a hot, crowded church and felt hot and sweaty and my vision went gray, then I passed out for a few seconds. I feel totally fine now. It's happened once before, same way.
clinical.presentationShort: 20yo M — classic vasovagal syncope with prodrome (warm, diaphoretic, tunnel vision), quick recovery, normal exam — benign.
clinical.presentationLong: 20-year-old male with classic vasovagal syncope preceded by warmth, diaphoresis, and tunnel vision while standing, with rapid full recovery and a normal exam.

diagnosis.disposition: Fast Track → clinician assessment and screening ECG, then reassurance and hydration if the evaluation remains reassuring.
diagnosis.why: Prodrome + trigger + quick full recovery in a young healthy person strongly support vasovagal syncope, but a patient presenting after syncope should still receive a brief clinician assessment and screening ECG before leaving the ED.

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
aiImageGeneration.pose: seated, looking a bit embarrassed, otherwise fine
aiImageGeneration.prompt: Softly-shaded painterly cartoon illustration in a semi-realistic Pixar/Disney style: smooth gradient shading, soft natural lighting, gentle rounded volumes, fine delicate outlines (NOT thick flat cartoon outlines), warm detailed rendering, natural realistic proportions, single character, 3/4 front view, centered, square 1:1. Match the exact painterly style, brushwork, shading, line weight, lighting, and palette of the attached reference image. Subject: a black 20-year-old man in nice church clothes, seated on a blue padded clinic chair. Pose: sitting up, looking a bit embarrassed. Expression: sheepish but completely well. Clearly visible: a healthy young man with no distress. No text, no logos.
